purpose: The still image processor (GNR.videoprocessor), driver side (y2s47). (1) Nord2Metal: a compute pipeline's function now reaches the library with the values it was specialised with (rwa_compute_create_constants), as a render pipeline's functions have since 25 October: until now every constant of every compute pipeline was a defined 0, so the six variants of the pyramid's kernel (pyramid_downsample: lumaWrite x chromaType) and the bilateral grid's were one kernel each. A function made without values is treated as before. A library lookup WITH values that Metal answers with nil (no ready-made variant in the library and no Apple compiler here) now gets the generic function, tied to the values, instead of nil. Both are off while /var/db/nord2-metal/no-compute-constants exists. (2) libredwoodair.dylib: the new entry point; and a texture write now stores four 32-bit components that say what they are (float / signed / unsigned) - a `half` value (air.write_texture_2d.v4f16: every write of the pyramid, the grid and the warps) was handed to Panfrost's compiler as 16-bit components with an unsized type, which its image store does not take. Host: all 52 functions of the processor's Metal library with every set of values its stages ask (205 variants) translate and compile for Valhall, and all 795 render pipelines are made by rwa_render_create. Previous files kept as /private/var/db/nord2-metal/{libredwoodair.dylib,Nord2Metal}.pre-vt7; receipt.json inventory updated. Undo: guest-vt7-undo.sh. NEEDS the bundle's FigM2MController change (camera-userland rwcam_diag.c) for the processor to be made at all.
